svg.title: Generation ZX Founders, paperback full wrap: One letter more
svg.desc: Back, spine and front, 6 by 9 inches trim, 0.125 inch bleed, spine 0.495 inches for 220 pages.
svg.text: I keep coming back to the same question: who am I talking to? The
answer is the founder, the person who is already motivated, already a
minority, already up at three in the morning building because finally they
can, and it does not matter what generation they are.
So Generation ZX is not a range of birth years. It is the people building
because finally they can. We see it most in Generation Z and Generation
X, which is why the two letters are on the cover, but a millennial who
builds at three in the morning is one of them too.
We should say how many companies we helped along the way.
Some got created and some did not.
The book is built in public at gen-z-developers.sgit.ai
For the ones already up at
UNDERSTAND WHAT GAME IS BEING PLAYED
